104/* Sub block ID: 0x0080, ICD API: AWR_CHAN_CONF_SET_SB */
105/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_009 */
106/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-752, AUTORADAR_REQ-757, AUTORADAR_REQ-970, AUTORADAR_REQ-1130 */
107rlReturnVal_t rlSetChannelConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlChanCfg_t* data)
108{
109 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
110
111 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
112 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || (RL_NULL_PTR == data))
113 {
114 /* set return error code */
115 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
116 }
117 else
118 {
119 /* Package the command with given data and send it to device */
120 retVal = rlDriverExecuteSetApi(deviceMap, RL_RF_STATIC_CONF_SET_MSG,
121 RL_RF_CHAN_CONF_SB, (rlUInt8_t*)data,
122 (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlChanCfg_t));
123 }
124
125 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetChannelConfig ends...\n");
126 return retVal;
127
128}

282/* Sub block ID: 0x0181, ICD API: AWR_BPM_CHIRP_CONF_SET_SB */
283/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_122 */
284/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-727 */
285rlReturnVal_t rlSetMultiBpmChirpConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlUInt16_t cnt,
286 rlBpmChirpCfg_t** data)
287{
288 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
289 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetMultiBpmChirpConfig starts...\n");
290
291 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
292 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || (RL_NULL_PTR == data) || \
293 (cnt == 0U))
294 {
295 /* set return error code */
296 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
297 }
298 else
299 {
300 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
301 rlDriverMsg_t inMsg;
302 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
303
304 /* Index and other paramerters to send multiple sub blocks in one/more commands chunk */
305 rlUInt16_t sbLen, maxSbCntInMsg, sbCntInMsg, numChnkOfMsg, lastSbCntInMsg, loopCnt, indx;
306
307
308 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
309 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb[RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX/(sizeof(rlBpmChirpCfg_t) + \
310 RL_SBC_ID_SIZE + RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE)];
311
312 /* single sub-block length for chirp config API */
313 sbLen = (rlUInt16_t)(sizeof(rlBpmChirpCfg_t) + (RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE + RL_SBC_ID_SIZE));
314
315 /* get Max Sub Block count */
316 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:D.4.1 <APPROVED> "sbLen can not be zero" */
317 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 127 D */
318 maxSbCntInMsg = (RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX /sbLen);
319
320 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_OK;
321 /* if requested count of chirpConfig is within one Message packet */
322 if (cnt <= maxSbCntInMsg)
323 {
324 sbCntInMsg = cnt;
325 numChnkOfMsg = 1U;
326 lastSbCntInMsg = 0U;
327 }
328 else
329 {
330 sbCntInMsg = maxSbCntInMsg;
331 numChnkOfMsg = cnt / maxSbCntInMsg;
332 lastSbCntInMsg = cnt % maxSbCntInMsg;
333 }
334
335 /* Fill in-message packet */
336 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_ADVANCED_FEATURES_SET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb[0]);
337
338 loopCnt = (lastSbCntInMsg == 0U) ? numChnkOfMsg : (numChnkOfMsg + 1U);
339
340 while (retVal == RL_RET_CODE_OK)
341 {
342 /* all full messages have been sent, then send last partial message */
343 if ((loopCnt == 1U) && (lastSbCntInMsg != 0U))
344 {
345 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = lastSbCntInMsg;
346 }
347 else
348 {
349 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = sbCntInMsg;
350 }
351
352 for (indx = 0U; indx < inMsg.opcode.nsbc; indx++)
353 {
354 /* Set Command Sub Block*/
355 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
356 LDRA Tool Issue" */
357 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
358 inPayloadSb[indx].sbid = RL_GET_UNIQUE_SBID(RL_RF_ADVANCED_FEATURES_SET_MSG,
359 RL_RF_BPM_CHIRP_CONF_SB);
360 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
361 LDRA Tool Issue" */
362 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
363 inPayloadSb[indx].len = (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlBpmChirpCfg_t);
364 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
365 LDRA Tool Issue" */
366 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
367 inPayloadSb[indx].pSblkData = (rlUInt8_t*)(*data);
368
369 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.1 <APPROVED> "require pointer increment to jump to
370 next profile Config */
371 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 567 S */
372 data++;
373 }
374 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
375 retVal += rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
376 loopCnt--;
377
378 if (loopCnt == 0U)
379 {
380 break;
381 }
382 }
383 }
384 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetMultiBpmChirpConfig ends...\n");
385
386 return retVal;
387}

452/* Sub block ID: 0x0100, ICD API: AWR_PROFILE_CONF_SET_SB */
453/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_013 */
454/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-728, AUTORADAR_REQ-729, AUTORADAR_REQ-730, AUTORADAR_REQ-731,
455 AUTORADAR_REQ-732, AUTORADAR_REQ-733, AUTORADAR_REQ-734, AUTORADAR_REQ-735,
456 AUTORADAR_REQ-736, AUTORADAR_REQ-737, AUTORADAR_REQ-738, AUTORADAR_REQ-739,
457 AUTORADAR_REQ-740, AUTORADAR_REQ-741, AUTORADAR_REQ-742, AUTORADAR_REQ-743,
458 AUTORADAR_REQ-773
459 */
460rlReturnVal_t rlSetProfileConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlUInt16_t cnt,
461 rlProfileCfg_t* data)
462{
463 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
464
465 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetProfileConfig starts...\n");
466
467 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
468 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || \
469 (RL_NULL_PTR == data) || (cnt == 0U))
470 {
471 /* set return error code */
472 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
473 RL_LOGE_ARG0("rlSetProfileConfig, Invalid device map\n");
474 }
475 else
476 {
477 rlDriverMsg_t inMsg = {0};
478 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
479
480 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
481 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb[RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX/(sizeof(rlProfileCfg_t) + \
482 RL_SBC_ID_SIZE + RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE)];
483 /* Variable to count message chunks */
484 rlUInt16_t indx;
485 rlUInt16_t sbCntInAllChunk = 0U, moduloIndex;
486 rlUInt16_t maxSbInMsg = (RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX /(sizeof(rlProfileCfg_t) + \
487 RL_SBC_ID_SIZE + RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE));
488
489 /* Construct command packet */
490 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb[0]);
491
492 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_OK;
493 /* Loop to copy all the command data to one message */
494 for (indx = 0U; (indx < cnt) && (retVal == RL_RET_CODE_OK); indx++)
495 {
496 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:D.4.1 <APPROVED> "maxSbInMsg can not be zero" */
497 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 127 D */
498 moduloIndex = indx % maxSbInMsg;
499
500 /* Fill in-message payload */
501 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.1 <APPROVED> "require pointer increment to jump to
502 next profile Config */
503 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.4 <APPROVED> "require pointer increment to jump to
504 next profile Config */
505 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 87 S */
506 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 567 S */
507 rlDriverFillPayload(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG, RL_RF_PROFILE_CONF_SB,
508 &inPayloadSb[moduloIndex], (rlUInt8_t*)(data + indx),
509 (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlProfileCfg_t));
510
511 /* increment Sub-block count in one packet */
512 sbCntInAllChunk++;
513
514 /* check if total payload length is going beyond defined limitation */
515 if ((maxSbInMsg == (moduloIndex + 1U)) || (cnt == sbCntInAllChunk))
516 {
517 /* setting of numSBC to inMsg */
518 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = moduloIndex + 1U;
519 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
520 retVal += rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
521 }
522 }
523 }
524
525 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetProfileConfig ends...\n");
526
527 return retVal;
528}

543/* Sub block ID: 0x0120, ICD API: AWR_PROFILE_CONF_GET_SB */
544/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_118 */
545/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-728, AUTORADAR_REQ-729, AUTORADAR_REQ-730, AUTORADAR_REQ-731,
546AUTORADAR_REQ-732, AUTORADAR_REQ-733, AUTORADAR_REQ-734, AUTORADAR_REQ-735,
547AUTORADAR_REQ-736, AUTORADAR_REQ-737, AUTORADAR_REQ-738, AUTORADAR_REQ-739,
548AUTORADAR_REQ-740, AUTORADAR_REQ-741, AUTORADAR_REQ-742, AUTORADAR_REQ-743,
549AUTORADAR_REQ-773
550*/
551rlReturnVal_t rlGetProfileConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlUInt16_t profileId, rlProfileCfg_t* data)
552{
553 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
554
555 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlGetProfileConfig ends...\n");
556
557 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
558 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || \
559 (RL_NULL_PTR == data))
560 {
561 /* set return error code */
562 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
563 RL_LOGE_ARG0("rlGetProfileConfig, Invalid device map\n");
564 }
565 else
566 {
567 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
568 rlDriverMsg_t inMsg = {0};
569 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
570 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb = {0};
571 rlPayloadSb_t outPayloadSb = {0};
572 rlWordParam_t wordParam;
573 /* combine half words into WORD structure */
574 wordParam.halfWordOne = profileId;
575 wordParam.halfWordTwo = 0U;
576
577 /* Construct command packet */
578 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_GET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb);
579 /* Fill in-message Payload */
580 rlDriverFillPayload(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_GET_MSG, RL_RF_PROFILE_CONF_SB, &inPayloadSb,
581 (rlUInt8_t*)&wordParam, (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlWordParam_t));
582
583 /* Construct response packet */
584 rlDriverConstructOutMsg(1U, &outMsg, &outPayloadSb);
585 /* Fill in-message Payload */
586 rlDriverFillPayload(0U, 0U, &outPayloadSb, (rlUInt8_t*)data, 0U);
587
588 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
589 retVal = rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
590 }
591
592 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlGetProfileConfig ends...\n");
593 return retVal;
594}

754 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
755 rlChirpCfg_t *chirpCfgData = data;
756
757 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlGetChirpConfig starts...\n");
758
759 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
760 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || \
761 (RL_NULL_PTR == chirpCfgData))
762 {
763 /* set return error code */

771 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
772 /* Index and other paramerters to send multiple sub blocks in one/more commands chunk */
773 rlUInt16_t sbLen, maxSbCntOutMsg, sbCntOutMsg, numChnkOfMsg, lastSbCntOutMsg, loopCnt;
774
775 /* file chirp start and end index */
776 rlWordParam_t wordParam;
777
778 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb = {0};
779 rlPayloadSb_t outPayloadSb;
780
781 /* single sub-block length for chirp config API */
782 sbLen = (rlUInt16_t)(sizeof(rlChirpCfg_t));
783
784 /* get Max Sub Block count */
785 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:D.4.1 <APPROVED> "sbLen can not be zero" */
786 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 127 D */
787 maxSbCntOutMsg = (RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX -(RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE + RL_SBC_ID_SIZE)) /sbLen;
788
789 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_OK;
790 /* if requested count of chirpConfig is within one Message packet */
791 if ((chirpEndIdx - chirpStartIdx + 1U) <= maxSbCntOutMsg)
792 {
793 sbCntOutMsg = (chirpEndIdx - chirpStartIdx + 1U);
794 numChnkOfMsg = 0U;
795 lastSbCntOutMsg = 0U;
796 }
797 else
798 {
799 sbCntOutMsg = maxSbCntOutMsg;
800 numChnkOfMsg = (chirpEndIdx - chirpStartIdx + 1U) / maxSbCntOutMsg;
801 lastSbCntOutMsg = (chirpEndIdx - chirpStartIdx + 1U) % maxSbCntOutMsg;
802 }
803 /* set chirp start index to inMsg field */
804 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "required to intial with startIdx" */
805 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 8 D */
806 wordParam.halfWordTwo = chirpStartIdx;
807
808 /* get the loop count in form of number of msg chunks */
809 loopCnt = numChnkOfMsg + 1U;
810 /* setting num of sub-block to one in outMsg */
811 outMsg.opcode.nsbc = 1U;
812
813 while (retVal == RL_RET_CODE_OK)
814 {
815 /* combine half words into WORD structure */
816 wordParam.halfWordOne = wordParam.halfWordTwo;
817 /* all full messages have been sent, then send last partial message */
818 if ((loopCnt == 1U) && (lastSbCntOutMsg != 0U))
819 {
820 wordParam.halfWordTwo = wordParam.halfWordOne + (lastSbCntOutMsg - 1U);
821 }
822 else
823 {
824 wordParam.halfWordTwo = wordParam.halfWordOne + (sbCntOutMsg - 1U);
825 }
826
827 /* Construct command packet */
828 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_GET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb);
829 /* Fill in-message Payload */
830 rlDriverFillPayload(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_GET_MSG, RL_RF_CHIRP_CONF_SB, &inPayloadSb,
831 (rlUInt8_t*)&wordParam, (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlWordParam_t));
832
833 /* Set Command Sub Block*/
834 outPayloadSb.sbid = RL_GET_UNIQUE_SBID(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_GET_MSG,
835 RL_RF_CHIRP_CONF_SB);
836 outPayloadSb.len = (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlChirpCfg_t);
837 outPayloadSb.pSblkData = (rlUInt8_t*)(chirpCfgData);
838
839 /* Construct response packet */
840 rlDriverConstructOutMsg(outMsg.opcode.nsbc, &outMsg, &outPayloadSb);
841
842 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
843 retVal += rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
844
845 /* increment data pointer for next chunk of reponse */
846 chirpCfgData += sbCntOutMsg;
847
848 /* decrement the loop count */
849 loopCnt--;
850 wordParam.halfWordTwo++;
851 /* if all chirp configurations have been sent to device then terminate the loop */
852 if (loopCnt == 0U)
853 {
854 break;
855 }
856 }
857 }
858
859 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlGetChirpConfig ends...\n");
860
861 return retVal;
862}

908 /* Index and other paramerters to send multiple sub blocks in one/more commands chunk */
909 rlUInt16_t sbLen, maxSbCntInMsg, sbCntInMsg, numChnkOfMsg, lastSbCntInMsg, loopCnt, indx;
910

912 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
913 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb[RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX/(sizeof(rlChirpCfg_t) + \
914 RL_SBC_ID_SIZE + RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE)];

916 /* single sub-block length for chirp config API */

931 lastSbCntInMsg = 0U;
932 }
933 else

937 lastSbCntInMsg = cnt % maxSbCntInMsg;
938 }
939
940 /* Fill in-message packet */
941 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb[0]);
942
943 loopCnt = (lastSbCntInMsg == 0U) ? numChnkOfMsg : (numChnkOfMsg + 1U);

952 else

954 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = sbCntInMsg;

957 for (indx = 0U; indx < inMsg.opcode.nsbc; indx++)

967 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */

969 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
970 LDRA Tool Issue" */
971 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
972 inPayloadSb[indx].pSblkData = (rlUInt8_t*)(*data);
973
974 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.1 <APPROVED> "require pointer increment to jump to
975 next profile Config */
976 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 567 S */
977 data++;
978 }
979 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
980 retVal += rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
981 loopCnt--;
982
983 if (loopCnt == 0U)
984 {
985 break;
986 }
987 }
988 }
989 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetMultiChirpCfg ends...\n");
990 return retVal;

2128/* Sub block ID: 0x0106, ICD API: AWR_PERCHIRPPHASESHIFT_CONF_SB */
2129/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_045 */
2130/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-798 */
2131rlReturnVal_t rlRfSetPhaseShiftConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlUInt16_t cnt,
2132 rlRfPhaseShiftCfg_t* data)
2133{
2134 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
2135
2136 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlRfSetPhaseShiftConfig starts...\n");
2137
2138 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
2139 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || \
2140 (RL_NULL_PTR == data) || (cnt == 0U))
2141 {
2142 /* set return error code */
2143 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
2144 }
2145 else
2146 {
2147 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
2148 rlDriverMsg_t inMsg;
2149 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
2150 /* Index and other paramerters to send multiple sub blocks in one/more commands chunk */
2151 rlUInt16_t sbLen, maxSbCntInMsg, sbCntInMsg, numChnkOfMsg, lastSbCntInMsg, loopCnt, indx;
2152
2153 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
2154 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb[RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX/(sizeof(rlRfPhaseShiftCfg_t) + \
2155 RL_SBC_ID_SIZE + RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE)];
2156
2157 /* single sub-block length for chirp config API */
2158 sbLen = (rlUInt16_t)(sizeof(rlRfPhaseShiftCfg_t) + (RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE + RL_SBC_ID_SIZE));
2159
2160 /* get Max Sub Block count */
2161 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:D.4.1 <APPROVED> "sbLen can not be zero" */
2162 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 127 D */
2163 maxSbCntInMsg = (RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX /sbLen);
2164
2165 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_OK;
2166 /* if requested count of chirpConfig is within one Message packet */
2167 if (cnt <= maxSbCntInMsg)
2168 {
2169 sbCntInMsg = cnt;
2170 numChnkOfMsg = 1U;
2171 lastSbCntInMsg = 0U;
2172 }
2173 else
2174 {
2175 sbCntInMsg = maxSbCntInMsg;
2176 numChnkOfMsg = cnt / maxSbCntInMsg;
2177 lastSbCntInMsg = cnt % maxSbCntInMsg;
2178 }
2179
2180 /* Fill in-message packet */
2181 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb[0]);
2182 /* get the loop count in form of number of msg chunks */
2183 loopCnt = (lastSbCntInMsg == 0U) ? numChnkOfMsg : (numChnkOfMsg + 1U);
2184
2185 while (retVal == RL_RET_CODE_OK)
2186 {
2187 /* all full messages have been sent, then send last partial message */
2188 if ((loopCnt == 1U) && (lastSbCntInMsg != 0U))
2189 {
2190 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = lastSbCntInMsg;
2191 }
2192 else
2193 {
2194 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = sbCntInMsg;
2195 }
2196
2197 for (indx = 0U; indx < inMsg.opcode.nsbc; indx++)
2198 {
2199 /* Set Command Sub Block*/
2200 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
2201 LDRA Tool Issue" */
2202 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
2203 inPayloadSb[indx].sbid = RL_GET_UNIQUE_SBID(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG,
2204 RL_RF_PERCHIRPPHASESHIFT_CONF_SB);
2205 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
2206 LDRA Tool Issue" */
2207 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
2208 inPayloadSb[indx].len = (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlRfPhaseShiftCfg_t);
2209 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
2210 LDRA Tool Issue" */
2211 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
2212 inPayloadSb[indx].pSblkData = (rlUInt8_t*)(data);
2213 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.1 <APPROVED> "require pointer increment to jump to \
2214 next chirp Config */
2215 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 567 S */
2216 data++;
2217 }
2218 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
2219 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
2220 LDRA Tool Issue" */
2221 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
2222 retVal += rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
2223 /* decrement the loop count */
2224 loopCnt--;
2225 /* if all phase shift configs have been sent to device then terminate the loop */
2226 if (loopCnt == 0U)
2227 {
2228 break;
2229 }
2230 }
2231 }
2232
2233 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlRfSetPhaseShiftConfig ends...\n");
2234
2235 return retVal;
2236}

3105/* Sub block ID: 0x010F, ICD API: AWR_DYN_CHIRP_CONF_SET_SB */
3106/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_063 */
3107/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-902 */
3108rlReturnVal_t rlSetDynChirpCfg(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlUInt16_t segCnt,
3109 rlDynChirpCfg_t **data)
3110{
3111 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
3112
3113 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
3114 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || (RL_NULL_PTR == data) || \
3115 (segCnt == 0U))
3116 {
3117 /* set return error code */
3118 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
3119 }
3120 else
3121 {
3122 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
3123 rlDriverMsg_t inMsg;
3124 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
3125
3126 /* Index and other paramerters to send multiple sub blocks in one/more commands chunk */
3127 rlUInt16_t sbLen, maxSbCntInMsg, sbCntInMsg, numChnkOfMsg, lastSbCntInMsg, loopCnt, indx;
3128
3129
3130 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
3131 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb[RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX/(sizeof(rlDynChirpCfg_t) + \
3132 RL_SBC_ID_SIZE + RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE)];
3133
3134 /* single sub-block length for chirp config API */
3135 sbLen = (rlUInt16_t)(sizeof(rlDynChirpCfg_t) + (RL_SBC_LEN_SIZE + RL_SBC_ID_SIZE));
3136
3137
3138 /* get Max Sub Block count */
3139 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:D.4.1 <APPROVED> "sbLen can not be zero" */
3140 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 127 D */
3141 maxSbCntInMsg = (RL_CMD_PL_LEN_MAX /sbLen);
3142
3143 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_OK;
3144 /* if requested count of chirpConfig is within one Message packet */
3145 if (segCnt <= maxSbCntInMsg)
3146 {
3147 sbCntInMsg = segCnt;
3148 numChnkOfMsg = 1U;
3149 lastSbCntInMsg = 0U;
3150 }
3151 else
3152 {
3153 sbCntInMsg = maxSbCntInMsg;
3154 numChnkOfMsg = segCnt / maxSbCntInMsg;
3155 lastSbCntInMsg = segCnt % maxSbCntInMsg;
3156 }
3157
3158 /* Fill in-message packet */
3159 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb[0]);
3160
3161 loopCnt = (lastSbCntInMsg == 0U) ? numChnkOfMsg : (numChnkOfMsg + 1U);
3162
3163 while (retVal == RL_RET_CODE_OK)
3164 {
3165 /* all full messages have been sent, then send last partial message */
3166 if ((loopCnt == 1U) && (lastSbCntInMsg != 0U))
3167 {
3168 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = lastSbCntInMsg;
3169 }
3170 else
3171 {
3172 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = sbCntInMsg;
3173 }
3174
3175 for (indx = 0U; indx < inMsg.opcode.nsbc; indx++)
3176 {
3177 /* Set Command Sub Block*/
3178 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
3179 LDRA Tool Issue" */
3180 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
3181 inPayloadSb[indx].sbid = RL_GET_UNIQUE_SBID(RL_RF_DYNAMIC_CONF_SET_MSG,
3182 RL_RF_DYN_CHIRP_CFG_SET_SB);
3183 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
3184 LDRA Tool Issue" */
3185 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
3186 inPayloadSb[indx].len = (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlDynChirpCfg_t);
3187 /* AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "Values are used by called function. \
3188 LDRA Tool Issue" */
3189 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 105 D */
3190 inPayloadSb[indx].pSblkData = (rlUInt8_t*)(*data);
3191
3192 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.1 <APPROVED> "require pointer increment to jump to \
3193 next Config */
3194 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 567 S */
3195 data++;
3196 }
3197 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
3198 retVal += rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
3199 loopCnt--;
3200
3201 if (loopCnt == 0U)
3202 {
3203 break;
3204 }
3205 }
3206 }
3207 return retVal;
3208}

4505/* Sub block ID: 0x0116, ICD API: AWR_ADVANCE_CHIRP_GENERIC_LUT_LOAD_SB */
4506/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_131 */
4507/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-1050, AUTORADAR_REQ-1125, AUTORADAR_REQ-1129 */
4508/*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.2.2 <APPROVED> "numBytes is re initialized under different conditions" */
4509/*LDRA_INSPECTED 8 D */
4510rlReturnVal_t rlSetMultiAdvChirpLUTConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap,
4511 rlAdvChirpLUTCfg_t* AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs,
4512 rlInt8_t* AdvChirpLUTData)
4513{
4514 rlReturnVal_t retVal = RL_RET_CODE_OK;
4515 /* Structure used to send the LUT RAM data to populate the LUT at the device end */
4516 rlAdvChirpLUTCfg_t AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk = { 0 };
4517 /* Variables to keep track of the number of chunks and the chunk size */
4518 rlUInt16_t chunkCount = 0U, totalChunkCount, lastChunkSize;
4519
4520 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetMultiAdvChirpLUTConfig starts...\n");
4521
4522 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
4523 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || \
4524 (RL_NULL_PTR == AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs) || (RL_NULL_PTR == AdvChirpLUTData))
4525 {
4526 /* set return error code */
4527 retVal += RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
4528 RL_LOGE_ARG0("rlSetMultiAdvChirpLUTConfig, Invalid input params\n");
4529 }
4530 else
4531 {
4532 RL_LOGV_ARG2("rlSetMultiAdvChirpLUTConfig with \nlutAddOffset[%d]\nnumBytes[%d] \n\n",\
4533 AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->lutAddressOffset, AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes);
4534
4535 /* If the LUT size to be programmed is more than 212 bytes, then break them into chunks
4536 of 212 bytes and send them one after the other over SPI */
4537 if (AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes > RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE)
4538 {
4539 /* If the overall LUT size is a multiple of 212 bytes */
4540 if ((AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes % RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE) == 0U)
4541 {
4542 lastChunkSize = RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE;
4543 totalChunkCount = \
4544 (rlUInt16_t)(AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes / RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE);
4545 }
4546 /* Else, keep track of the remaining bytes in the last chunk */
4547 else
4548 {
4549 totalChunkCount = \
4550 (rlUInt16_t)((AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes/RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE) + 1U);
4551 lastChunkSize = \
4552 (rlUInt16_t)(AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes % RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE);
4553 }
4554 }
4555 /* If the total size of the LUT to be programmed is less than 212 bytes, it can be
4556 sent in a single chunk */
4557 else
4558 {
4559 totalChunkCount = 1U;
4560 /* last chunk size is same as total number of bytes in this case */
4561 lastChunkSize = AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->numBytes;
4562 }
4563
4564 while (chunkCount < totalChunkCount)
4565 {
4566 RL_LOGV_ARG1("Sending Advanced Chirp LUT data Chunk [%d]... \n\n", chunkCount);
4567 /* Update the LUT Address offset for every chunk */
4568 AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.lutAddressOffset = \
4569 (rlUInt16_t)(AdvChirpLUTCfgArgs->lutAddressOffset + \
4570 (chunkCount * RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE));
4571
4572 /* If the data belongs to last chunk or if it is a single chunk */
4573 if (chunkCount == (totalChunkCount - 1U))
4574 {
4575 AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.numBytes = lastChunkSize;
4576 }
4577 /* For other intermediate chunks, send the entire length of 212 bytes */
4578 else
4579 {
4580 AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.numBytes = RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE;
4581 }
4582
4583 if (AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.numBytes > 0U)
4584 {
4585 /* Copy the input AdvChirpLUTData to LUT structure */
4586 /*AR_CODE_REVIEW MR:R.18.1 <INSPECTED> "Accessing pointer as array"*/
4587 /*LDRA_INSPECTED 436 S */
4588 (void)memcpy(&AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.calData[0U], \
4589 &AdvChirpLUTData[chunkCount * RL_MAX_ADV_CHIRP_LUT_CHUNK_SIZE], \
4590 AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.numBytes);
4591
4592 RL_LOGV_ARG2("rlSetAdvChirpLUTConfig with \nlutAddOffset[%d]\nnumBytes[%d] \n\n",\
4593 AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.lutAddressOffset, AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.numBytes);
4594 /* Send the LUT RAM structure (chunk) to the device */
4595 retVal += rlSetAdvChirpLUTConfig(deviceMap, &AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk);
4596
4597 if (retVal != RL_RET_CODE_OK)
4598 {
4599 RL_LOGV_ARG2("Advanced Chirp LUT data Chunk [%d] failed with error code %d",\
4600 chunkCount, retVal);
4601 break;
4602 }
4603 }
4604 else
4605 {
4606 /* set return error code */
4607 retVal += RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
4608 RL_LOGV_ARG2("Invalid input, Chirp LUT Chunk [%d] is programmed with %d bytes",\
4609 chunkCount, AdvChirpLUTCfgChunk.numBytes);
4610 }
4611
4612 chunkCount++;
4613 }
4614 }
4615
4616 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlSetMultiAdvChirpLUTConfig ends...\n");
4617
4618 return retVal;
4619}
